name: estimated-progress
title: Estimated progress
description: A bar for work with no progress signal: it eases toward 90 percent on an expected duration and only finishes when the work does.
docs: Give it expectedMs and a status (running, done or failed). The fill follows an ease-out curve toward 90 percent and never reaches it by itself; done fills the rest, failed freezes it in the destructive tone. It says About 30 seconds at first and Still working once the expected time has passed. Pass startedAt when the work began before the component mounted. Under reduced motion the fill moves in 10 percent steps.
